description:
On 0.28.0 with Claude Code 2.1.329 in a remote Linux pane, an urgent post reached a Claude Code pane while it waited at a Bash permission dialog. Once the person declined the command, Muster typed its wake line into the prompt and never pressed Return, so the pane sat idle. The sender's `msg who` said the wake was held because the prompt held typed, unsent text, and that text was Muster's own wake. One `muster pane send --enter` submitted it and the agent read the message.

This is the case a_2vgam6tPd fixed for a notice cleared by hand (cf8e5c31 looks at an at-work ring's prompt again after each Return), reached by a different path: the ring follows a dialog closing rather than a turn ending. When the idle prompt holds exactly the wake text Muster typed, Muster should submit it; when anything else is in the prompt, it should keep holding. From tooling feedback a_33FVFKUiK.
title: A wake typed into a Claude Code prompt after a declined permission dialog is left unsent
